title: Study quiz card in the chat (round 2, design A)

steps.path: A chat where the assistant quizzes you
steps.headline: Study quiz: answer questions in a card inside the assistant's reply.
steps.hint: Click the second practice conversation in the session list (amber dot). Pick an answer, press Next question, go through to the score, try Retake.
steps.notice: Builder's main gaps: the guide has NO recipe for cards inside the chat; the normal card style vanishes inside a chat bubble; no neutral notice colour (the explanation box turns hot pink in Halftone).
steps.risk: Sending your score to the assistant is faked.

steps.headline: Quiz finished: the score and what you missed.
Quiz when your score couldn't be sent to the assistant.
steps.hint: Second practice conversation (amber dot). Try again works on the second press.
